title: The Value of Perfect Endpoint Forecasts for Offshore-Wind Thermal Firming
summary: Forecast value depends not only on accuracy but also on the information structure available to the operating model. We study a diagnostic current-endpoint-only forecast for offshore-wind thermal firming: at hour t, the controller observes the current net-demand state z_t and one perfect future target z_{t+h}, but not the intermediate path or earlier endpoint messages. Unlike rolling path forecasts, these endpoint information sets are not nested in h.
